snippet.title: Magical Princess | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
✨Steam Wishlist Available NOW!✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562120/_/

Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

VA
Alice - Sayumi Suzushiro

Official X : https://x.com/magiprincess
